colour_metric: CIE76 Delta E*ab, CIELAB D65, sRGB
grayscale_metric: Absolute difference in CIE L* (0-100); 15 points
grayscale_scope_authorization: User explicitly confirmed S/B, Q/C and M/N actual comparison pairs; all 28 pairs still require Delta E >= 30.
outline_note: 3:1 is a conservative rendering trigger chosen for this proposal, not a claimed universal print threshold. Raw pastel colours below it are never claimed to pass a bare-line contrast test.
semantic_rules: The selected candidate, its role mapping and non-colour cues are frozen across P1/P2/P3 only after user approval.
Statistical baselines share B; C is reserved for classical optimisation methods.
M denotes gap=0, N denotes gap>0; near-positive P denotes observed development V<=2, not hidden V=0 or a prediction.
Colour is always accompanied by marker, dash, hatch or a direct label.
Thin lines below 3:1 raw contrast require the neutral outline; markers and bars require visible edges; translucent bands require boundaries.
Only S/B, Q/C and M/N are approved grayscale-series pairs. Other combinations need separate figure review and redundant cues; no claim that all 28 gray pairs pass.
No inventory or formal figure is produced before the corresponding user approval.
